stance_summary: USD pairs contaminate an Australia-versus-Canada policy and growth differential that already lives more cleanly in AUDCAD than in AUDUSD or USDCAD. Verified packet facts: AUDCAD is at a five-year extreme while AONIA is already restrictive and the Australian housing channel is biting, whereas CORRA remains far below AONIA with a larger remaining implied hike path and BoC energy pass-through risk. Inference: spot is still capitalizing the sticky AU yield premium rather than the remaining policy-path and housing-asymmetric. Unknown: NZ official rates, CA official curve, CME positioning, and executable broker mids. Primary expression is short AUDCAD, not a USD pair and not AUDNZD.

expression_comparison.rates_candidate: Long CA-AU 2Y (CA 2Y minus AU 2Y from -164.9bp toward less negative) / CORRA-path catch-up versus AONIA. Rejected as the primary because the 2Y gap is already a five-year cheap CA versus AU print while spot, not the yield gap, is the mapping error; this seat is also spot-only.
expression_comparison.spot_candidate: short AUDCAD (sell AUD, buy CAD) at the frozen ECB same-fixing mid
expression_comparison.rationale: The intended view is Australia already-restrictive-plus-housing-break versus Canada still-behind-the-curve-plus-energy pass-through. AUDUSD (1y 76th / 5y 84th) and USDCAD (1y 74th / 5y 87th) are milder than AUDCAD (1y 99.80th / 5y 99.96th), so USD/Fed/oil beta contaminates both dollar legs. AUDNZD is even more stretched on the 1m move but NZ official rates are unavailable, AU-NZ 2Y and AUDNZD-versus-AU-NZ-2Y are null, and carry cannot be measured; that is a worse-identified cross. Spot AUDCAD isolates the AU-CA differential the rates gap has already advertised.

context_build.causal_mechanism: Verified: AONIA 4.35 as of 17-Sep-2026 versus CORRA 2.29 as of 2026-09-17; ASX 30D AONIA prices a Mar-2027 implied 4.86 (+51bp) while MX CORRA 3m prices 3.13 by Mar-2027 (+84bp) and 3.65 by Jun-2028. Australian housing is now showing the tightening channel (NSW stamp-duty receipts -24% y/y in August, transaction volumes -18%, Sydney and Melbourne home values more than 7% below peak). Canada August headline CPI held at 3% with CPI-trim 1.9 and CPI-median 2.0, while BoC minutes flag higher energy pass-through. Inference: remaining tightening and energy-risk are larger in Canada from a much lower overnight starting point, while Australia's extra yield is already in the price and the housing channel is converting into AUD growth/policy risk. Closing mechanism is AUDCAD compression as that differential is recognized, not a claim that AU-CA 2Y must immediately go to zero.

context_build.known_vs_new_information: Known before this cutoff: Australia still has hot inflation (trimmed-mean CPI 3.6% y/y unchanged in July; headline 3.5% from 3.8%); AU 2Y 4.999% as of 2026-09-16 at 99th 1y/5y; CA core near target; CORRA far below AONIA; 2Y CA-AU spread -164.9bp as of 2026-09-16. New/marginal now: housing transmission is in hard state-tax and price data; BoC minutes flag energy pass-through; energy-market shock absorbers weaken while a Saudi Oman ship-to-ship workaround reduces the extreme oil-supply tail; CA Q2 real GDP +0.8% q/q versus AU Q2 +0.4%; CA employment -42k in August with wages +2.0% y/y from +2.8%; AU employment -15.8k in July. Inference: the yield gap was already known; the reason AUDCAD can reprice now is the housing print plus Canada’s remaining implied hike path, not a newly discovered 165bp 2Y differential.
context_build.market_implied_assumption: AUDCAD near parity at a five-year high assumes the 164.9bp 2Y AU yield premium and the 206bp AONIA-over-CORRA overnight gap continue to dominate CAD catch-up hiking and Australian housing damage, i.e. Australia remains the unique tight-for-longer high-carry currency and Canada’s implied path (CORRA 1m Dec 2.58 / 3m Mar-2027 3.13) does not re-rate CAD versus AUD.

Inference: the gap is already in rates (CA-AU 2Y 5y percentile 10.5, z_5y -1.63, but 1y percentile 51.4 — mid-pack on one year). Spot has gone further than the one-year rates gap and is treating a known carry advantage as a reason to keep buying AUD after the housing channel has started to break.

Marginal driver of the 1m FX move is CAD underperformance versus USD after the Fed hike, with AUDUSD little changed; that is exactly the USD contamination this seat refuses to own. trade.structure: outright spot short AUDCAD (ECB same-fixing reference cross; paper mark is the packet mid, not a broker quote)
trade.thesis: VERIFIED FACT: AUDCAD 0.9975768872320596 as of 2026-09-18 sits at 5y percentile 99.96 / z 2.76 while AONIA 4.35 already exceeds CORRA 2.29 by 206bp, AU 2Y is 4.999% versus CA 2Y 3.35% on 2026-09-16 (-164.9bp CA-AU), Australian housing is contracting on stamp-duty, volumes and prices, Canada’s core is near 2% with headline at 3%, and CORRA 3m still prices +84bp by Mar-2027 versus AONIA +51bp to 4.86. INFERENCE: USD expressions (short AUDUSD or long USDCAD) own Fed/USD/oil beta that both commodity currencies share; the residual that is actually extreme is AUD versus CAD. Spot is mapping a known carry advantage into a 5-year high after the RBA tightening channel has started to bite and while Canada still has the larger remaining implied hike path plus energy pass-through risk. UNKNOWN: NZ official yields, CA official zero curve, CME positioning, broker executables, and whether Saudi STS supply fully offsets BoC energy-pass-through. Fade AUDCAD, do not own USD.
trade.mispricing: The mispricing is the FX mapping, not the existence of an AU yield premium. CA-AU 2Y is already historically cheap for Canada on a 5y window (percentile 10.5) but only median on 1y; AUDCAD is maxed on both 1y and 5y and is more extreme than either USD pair. Markets are priced as if the 165bp 2Y / 206bp overnight AU advantage will keep buying AUD even as housing data arrive and as Canada’s remaining path is the one still in front.
why_now: Australian housing transmission is now in August state-tax and price data, converting a known RBA tightness into a growth/policy risk for AUD rather than a reason to extend a 5y AUDCAD high.
BoC minutes flag energy pass-through while CORRA still has a larger remaining implied hike path than AONIA; that is the Canada-side catalyst the USD pairs bury inside the Fed hike.
AUDCAD 1m gain is mostly USDCAD (CAD versus USD) plus a stable AUDUSD; the cross isolates the AU-CA residual the dollar expressions contaminate.
Sidecar is flat; SOFR 3.85% ACT/360 vig accrues on the full $100m whether deployed or not. Negative AUDCAD carry argues for moderate size, not for staying cash.

trade.invalidation: Mechanistic, no manufactured price: thesis fails if Australian housing transaction/value deterioration reverses while BoC withdraws energy pass-through risk, CORRA-implied hikes are priced out, and AUDCAD holds or extends the packet 5y extreme. Also fails if AU 2Y re-accelerates versus CA 2Y from the 2026-09-16 -164.9bp print because RBA leans into still-hot trimmed-mean inflation. Packet supplies no stop level.
catalysts: Further NSW/national housing volume, stamp-duty or price deterioration that forces RBA path risk to the downside.
Canadian energy CPI or BoC communication confirming pass-through while CORRA 3m holds or steepens versus AONIA.
AONIA strip stalling near 4.86-4.94 while MX CORRA continues to reprice higher from 2.29.
Any RBA commentary treating housing as a binding tightening channel rather than as collateral damage of a still-open hike cycle.
principal_risks: Negative carry: 164.9bp 2Y and 206bp AONIA-CORRA overnight; the short pays the packet’s richest measured G10 2Y/vol ratio.
AU inflation gauge 82 versus CA 55 and trimmed-mean CPI still 3.6% can keep RBA hiking and AUD bid.
CA labor is weak (employment -42k, wages +2.0% from +2.8%, unemployment 6.4%), which can delay BoC despite energy minutes.
Saudi Oman STS workaround and any oil-price ease reduce the CAD energy-premium path.
Continued USD melt-up after the Fed hike can keep dragging CAD via USDCAD even if AU-CA fundamentals converge.
Known gaps: stale market-state from NZ_rates, no CA official curve, no CME positioning, no broker executables.

conflict_synopsis.core_view: AUDCAD at a five-year extreme still prices Australia’s yield premium and ignores housing transmission plus Canada’s larger remaining hike/energy path; isolate that in the non-USD cross, not via USD.
conflict_synopsis.key_catalyst: Australian housing deterioration versus BoC energy pass-through and CORRA catch-up versus a already-restrictive AONIA path.
conflict_synopsis.key_invalidation: Housing channel reverses, BoC energy risk is withdrawn and CORRA hikes are priced out while AUDCAD holds the packet 5y extreme.

paper_actions.rationale: Flat sidecar; deploy half of the $100m gross cap in the isolated AU-versus-CA spot cross. Size is capped below full allocation because carry opposes (164.9bp 2Y / 206bp overnight) and CA labor is weak, but SOFR 3.85% vig on the undeployed remainder still favors putting on a defined-invalidation expression rather than staying 100% cash.
paper_actions.thesis: Short AUDCAD to own Australia housing/restrictive-policy risk versus Canada remaining-hike and energy-pass-through risk without USD contamination.
